title: Environmental Water Sample Collection Following Flooding
author: Grace Semabia Kpeli

steps.title: Prepare sterile bottles and label
steps.instruction: Ensure 1.5 L sterile wide‑mouth bottles are sealed, unopened, and label each with a unique sample identifier before field work.

steps.title: Prepare chilled transport boxes
steps.instruction: Line sterile styrofoam boxes with ice packs and keep the boxes sealed until samples are placed inside.

steps.title: Verify GPS device settings
steps.instruction: Confirm the handheld GPS is fully charged and set to record coordinates in decimal‑degrees (DD) format.

steps.title: Select and document sampling sites
steps.instruction: Choose sites representing all water source types (river bank, mid‑channel, ponds, wells, boreholes, domestic taps, puddles, canals, canal drains) in each community.

steps.title: Record GPS coordinates and site info
steps.instruction: At each site, record latitude and longitude with the GPS, then log the coordinates, unique site identifier, and site description in a field notebook.

steps.title: Don personal protective equipment
steps.instruction: Put on disposable gloves before sampling and replace gloves between sites to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Collect water sample
steps.instruction: Hold the sterile bottle by its base, immerse it below the water surface, remove the cap, allow 1.5 L of water to fill, then replace the cap firmly while the bottle remains submerged.

steps.title: Collect duplicate sample
steps.instruction: Repeat the collection at the same site to obtain a second 1.5 L sample, labeling it with the same site identifier plus a duplicate designation (e.g., Site‑01A and Site‑01B).

steps.title: Label bottles and record metadata
steps.instruction: Immediately using a waterproof marker, confirm or apply the unique identifier on the bottle cap and side, and record on the field notebook: site ID, GPS coordinates, date, time, source type, and any field observations.

steps.title: Place samples on ice
steps.instruction: Put the collected bottles into the pre‑iced styrofoam boxes and keep them on ice right after collection.

steps.title: Transport and process samples
steps.instruction: Transport the iced samples to the laboratory as soon as possible and process them within 24 hours of collection.
